companionSurfaces.entrypoint: App: `Overview > Subagents` (`Ctrl+Alt+O` / `Cmd+Option+O`) + clickable inline rows; CLI: `/agents` (`Enter` detail view, `K` kill), `Alt+J` approval jump, `Ctrl+K` fast-path approval, `@<agent>` direct messaging

companionSurfaces.entrypoint: App: `Overview > Review` (`N files changed > Review`) with inline line comments; CLI: `/diff` 3-view Interactive Diff Viewer (`All Changes`, `Per Turn`, `Commit Tree`, `C` inline comments)
companionSurfaces.guidance: Point users stopping to inspect changes to the Review pane (App) or `/diff` (CLI).

companionSurfaces.entrypoint: CLI: `/effort` interactive timeline gauge (`low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max` per model; `/effort <level>`; `agy -p "/effort" [--output-format json]`; `agy --effort <level>` one-run flag)
companionSurfaces.guidance: Fixed-budget models such as **Orchestrator** report effort as non-adjustable because Orchestrator dynamically routes between planner and executor.

companionSurfaces.entrypoint: CLI: `/context` proportional cell grid + token/checkpoint breakdown; `/usage` (`/quota`) live **Models & Quota** panel
companionSurfaces.guidance: Recommend `/usage` when checking live model quota ahead of cross-family `/arena` or `/swarm`, and `/context` when auditing session compaction.
